content.ascii:
[B] Diagram
============================================================
Diagram: repository-independent, read-only value
  +-- diagramId        stable service identity
  +-- revisionId       issued service revision identity
  +-- id               local canvas content key
  +-- revision         nonnegative integer
  |
  +-- content: DiagramContent
  |     revisionId = id + ":" + revision
  |     ascii / asciiSha256
  |     structure
  |       +-- kind: diagram
  |       +-- kind: tree
  |             parserVersion: ascii-tree-1 / ascii-tree-2
  |             rootIds / nodes[id]
  |               label, line, branch/start/end columns
  |               parentId?, childIds, foldRanges
  |
  +-- sourceContext
  |     contentHash = SHA256(content.ascii)
  |     binding?: sourceId / repositoryIdentity
  |       corpus: git-worktree | filesystem-documents
  |       domainProfileId: source-code | document
  |     mappings[] -- entityId -----------+
  |       sourceRangeIndex / sourceRangeId?|
  |                                      v
  |     evidence[entityId] -> sourceRanges[index]
  |       relative path, startLine, endLine, originalLines
  |
  +-- jumps?: DiagramJump[]
            |
            v
validateDiagram -> canonical content + hash + joins + jumps
  printable ASCII/LF, nonblank, at most 20,000 characters
diagramSource / queryDiagramSourceContext
  mappings() / entries() / forSelection(rect) / search(query)
visibleContentLines(content, collapsedIds) -> visible raw lines
